title: Type scale and spacing
why: Each new panel picks its own sizes, so the interface drifts a little with every change.

suggestions.title: Three sizes: 11 px for labels, 13 px for body, 15 px for titles
suggestions.why: The three most used today, so most of the interface stays as it is

suggestions.title: Keep 10, 11, 12, 13 and 15 px, and drop the half pixels
suggestions.why: Almost nothing moves, but five sizes is still a lot for one panel
